% An article with natbib in author-year mode, whose bibliography has no
% labels. natbib sets the list's \leftmargin to \bibhang and its \itemindent
% to -\leftmargin (\NAT@bibsetup), so each entry starts at the margin and its
% later lines are indented by \bibhang. The entries wrap at a narrow width.
% A second bibliography, with a \bibhang of 0pt, has no indent.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{natbib}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \citet{book}, \citep{paper}, and \citet{flat}.
\begin{thebibliography}{2}
\bibitem[Author(2000)]{book} Author, A. (2000). \emph{A Book with a Title
  Long Enough to Wrap onto a Second Line, Even on a Wide Screen}. A Publisher,
  A City.
\bibitem[Writer(2001)]{paper} Writer, B. (2001). A paper whose title is also
  long enough to wrap onto a second line, even on a wide screen. \emph{A
  Journal}, 1:1--10.
\end{thebibliography}
{\setlength{\bibhang}{0pt}
\begin{thebibliography}{1}
\bibitem[Flat(2002)]{flat} Flat, C. (2002). \emph{A Book}. A Publisher.
\end{thebibliography}}
\end{document}
